scenarios.behavior_goal: Warn the host agent when the current task resembles known mistakes or prior retrospectives.
scenarios.user_scenario: User starts work similar to a previous failure or repeated mistake.
scenarios.behavior_delta: Agent receives a source-backed checklist before planning and can interrupt risky execution during the task.
scenarios.user_explanation: Surface the checklist item, source, severity, and concrete suggestion rather than a generic warning.

scenarios.behavior_goal: Adapt response style and task pacing to durable user preference signals.
scenarios.user_scenario: User has accumulated persona signals that should change how the agent communicates.
scenarios.behavior_delta: Agent receives behavior prompts and user_cognitive_profile_v2 assertions derived from persona dimensions, corrections, interruptions and explicit preferences instead of using a generic style.
scenarios.user_explanation: Explain the behavior change as persona-derived guidance, keep raw profile evidence available for inspection, and record whether consuming profile assertions changed the action.

scenarios.behavior_goal: Recover prior project decisions and raw conversation evidence for long-running work.
scenarios.user_scenario: User asks about previous decisions, exact evidence, or how something was solved last time.
scenarios.behavior_delta: Agent routes raw-evidence questions to session_search, knowledge questions to context_aware_search, and mixed recall to both.
scenarios.user_explanation: State whether the answer is based on raw session evidence, distilled wiki knowledge, or both.

scenarios.behavior_goal: Block or warn on risky actions such as destructive operations, secrets, production changes, or analysis loops.
scenarios.user_scenario: User asks to commit, delete, mutate production-like state, or the agent keeps analyzing without action.
scenarios.behavior_delta: Agent receives alert/warn/info risk levels and can switch from planning to confirmation or action mode.
scenarios.user_explanation: Show the risk trigger and suggested next action, not only that a guard fired.

scenarios.behavior_goal: Proactively push relevant knowledge before the user explicitly asks for it, while allowing suppression.
scenarios.user_scenario: Current user input or working directory matches a high-confidence reminder topic.
scenarios.behavior_delta: Agent can surface a concise push with reason/confidence, then bind accept/ignore/dismiss/inaccurate/outdated feedback to that exact delivery event.
scenarios.user_explanation: Mention why the push was shown and ask/observe whether it was useful.

scenarios.behavior_goal: Nudge unresolved retrospectives or follow-ups at session start and wrap-up without spamming.
scenarios.user_scenario: There are pending system/user recap reminders with high score or force-open status.
scenarios.behavior_delta: Agent receives scored pending recap items, enters the three-question contract, writes confirmed recaps to the Wiki, waits for every required canonical consumer receipt, records structured skip effects, and durably corrects committed effects when feedback changes.
scenarios.user_explanation: Surface only a concise nudge when severity/force-open warrants it, ask exactly the three recap questions, do not call a recap consumed until required receipts are complete, expose partial/retryable corrections, and explain skip choices without blocking unrelated work.

scenarios.behavior_goal: Route contradictory knowledge to dispute/conflict handling rather than silently overwriting.
scenarios.user_scenario: New knowledge contradicts an existing claim or relation.
scenarios.behavior_delta: Agent/system routes conflicts to dispute pages or feedback instead of normal inbox writes.
scenarios.user_explanation: Explain that the system found conflicting evidence and needs arbitration.

scenarios.behavior_goal: Preserve why the user introduced knowledge and make that behavior/intent signal available to cognitive consumers.
scenarios.user_scenario: User actively provides a document, paste, or dialogue context that should become long-term knowledge with its intent and later verification state.
scenarios.behavior_delta: Distillation output carries user_behavior_intent, Wiki pages show why the knowledge was needed, and ObservationEngine can consume the resulting intent distribution.
scenarios.user_explanation: Explain the distilled knowledge together with why the user introduced it, whether the intent was verified, and what evidence supports that interpretation.

scenarios.behavior_goal: Tell the user when Mnemos lacks coverage and propose a concrete query or capture path.
scenarios.user_scenario: User asks about a topic with weak or missing knowledge coverage.
scenarios.behavior_delta: Agent receives blindspot_found plus suggested_query and can ask whether to research or record new knowledge.
scenarios.user_explanation: Say what is missing, what evidence was checked, and the next suggested query/action.

scenarios.behavior_goal: Explain why default-off modules are disabled, when they can be enabled, and what downstream behavior changes after consumption.
scenarios.user_scenario: A task would benefit from a cold-start, privacy, cost, watcher, daemon, or legacy module that is currently off.
scenarios.behavior_delta: Agent can inspect the module toggle contract, avoid turning on unwired/stale modules, and cite consumer effect metrics before enabling a costly or private path.
scenarios.user_explanation: Say why the module is off, what evidence would make it eligible, who consumes the output, and how rollback or auto-disable works.
